name: Quantum Field Theory
description: A theoretical framework that combines classical field theory, special relativity and quantum mechanics.

name: String Theory
description: A theoretical framework in which the point-like particles of particle physics are replaced by one-dimensional objects called strings.

name: Condensed Matter Physics
description: The field of physics that deals with the macroscopic and microscopic physical properties of matter.

name: Loop Quantum Gravity
description: A theory of quantum gravity, merging quantum mechanics and general relativity.

name: Fluid Dynamics
description: A subdiscipline of fluid mechanics that describes the flow of fluids—liquids and gases.

name: Plasma Physics
description: The study of charged particles and fluids interacting with self-consistent electric and magnetic fields.
